newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's o/n rates close slightly up at 20.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's o/n rates close slightly up at 20.75 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates closed slightly higher on Wednesday, but dealers said the rates moved at levels unchanged from Tuesday for most of the session.
The overnight rates finished at 20.75 percent compared with Tuesday's closing of 20.625 percent.
"I do not feel a movement neither up or down," said Krisztina Hortobagyi of Creditanstalt. "We hover around the one-week reverse repo (rate of 20.75 percent)."
Dealers said the market was balanced with the commercial banks keeping a substantial part of their surplus liquidity in reverse repo deals with the National Bank of Hungary (NBH).
Dealers said the movement of overnight rates will depend this week on how much money flows into reverse repo rates.
If lenders expect overnight rates to remain low in the near future, substantial funds may flow into one-week reverse repo deals and in the end this would push the overnight rates up, dealers said.
